products.name: Pinukpok (Abaca Silk)
products.description: Locally hand-pounded abaca silk renowned for its lustrous texture, used as premium fabric for Philippine Barong, formal gowns, and heirloom attire.
products.where_to_buy: Banquerohan Weaving Center, SEDCen, Legazpi City Public Market

products.name: Pili Nut Delights & Wellness
products.description: Harvested from the indigenous "Magic Tree" of Bicol, creating world-class culinary treats, pili oil skincare, and therapeutic wellness products.
products.where_to_buy: Albay Pilinut, Legazpi Pasalubong Center, SEDCen, City Malls, Legazpi Market

products.name: Woven Abaca Handicrafts
products.description: Intricately woven natural fiber crafts including eco-friendly fashion bags, dining placemats, decorative baskets, and Mayon souvenir keepsakes.
products.where_to_buy: Legazpi Pasalubong Area, SEDCen, Legazpi Public Market, Malls

festival.name: Ibalong Festival
festival.subtitle: Celebration of the Mythical Epic of Bicol
festival.description: An annual celebration commemorating the ancient Ibalong Epic of the three mythical warrior-heroes: Baltog, Handiong, and Bantong. Features theatrical street pageantry, mask-wearing dancers depicting mythical beasts (Oryol, Sarimaw, Rabot), and grand cultural parades.

mabuhay_gesture.title: The Mabuhay Gesture
mabuhay_gesture.description: The signature Filipino Brand of Service greeting with hand gently placed over the heart, symbolizing heartfelt welcome, sincerity, and authentic Legazpeño warmth.

welcome_traditions.title: Welcome Lei & Putong Ceremony
welcome_traditions.description: Traditional welcoming honor where distinguished guests are draped with a handcrafted native Bicol woven Lei necklace and crowned with the ceremonial Putong headdress.
